subject: Request: 15-min technical screen before full demo
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@shopverse.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick technical screen before full demo

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the fast response on the sign-up form — we filled out the self-serve and the AP team is keen to see Redwood. Before we block an hour for a full demo, can we do a short 15-minute technical screen to confirm model hosting options and the network/KMS requirements?

High-level context: Shopverse is evaluating a mix of hosted API for prototypes and a private deployment for PCI-adjacent workloads. We need to confirm:
- Does Redwood support VPC peering with AWS accounts?
- KMS/HSM integrations for key management?
- Typical cold-start latency for a 2k-token LLM on dedicated capacity?

If possible, include a quick availability window for a 15-min call today or tomorrow. I can also add our infra lead (Priya) if it helps.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform, Shopverse
liam.oneill@shopverse.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@shopverse.com>
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before full demo

Hi Liam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the context. A 15-minute technical triage makes total sense and is our usual step before the full walkthrough.

I have the following short windows available today/tomorrow (PT):
- Today 11:00–11:15 AM PT
- Today 3:30–3:45 PM PT
- Tomorrow 10:00–10:15 AM PT

If none of those work, please tell me a couple of slots that do and I’ll try to match. Also: please add Priya if you want her on the call — that will be helpful for the KMS/infra bits.

To help our engineer prep, could you quickly confirm:
- whether Shopverse would prefer hosted API or a private VPC deployment for the pilot (rough preference is fine),
- any compliance constraints (SOC2, PCI, or company-specific), and
- the target p95 latency you care about for inference (ballpark).

I’ve attached a onepager that outlines our hosting modes and typical integrations. I’ll tentatively hold the 11:00 slot for 15 mins and will release it if you pick a different time.

Thanks,
Sooygin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
(Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf)

Thanks, Soojin. 11:00 is perfect but I just realized we have a conflict — can we move to today 3:30 instead? I’ll add Priya (priya.reddy@shopverse.com) on this thread so she can join.

Also, quick answers to your questions:
- Pilot preference: hosted API for the initial prototype, private deployment later for PCI scope
- Compliance: PCI scope for checkout flows, SOC2 is a plus but not mandatory for the POC
- Latency target: p95 ~ 200–300 ms for 512-token requests (we understand this varies a lot by model and hardware)

Looking forward to the call — thanks for being flexible.
